feature: First-run redesign — an account with no collection
note: Signed in as an account with no collection and no decks (the onboarding probe account). Photographs first run's checklist, the locked chrome it sits in (the rail's well at 1300, the bracket over the tab bar at 390), the locked chrome on /collection where a locked slot is also the current route, and first run's embedded review of a pasted list. The chrome is outside <main>, so no step can press it; the note, its caret and Go to step 1 are measured by `pnpm probe:locked-nav`, and the unlock by `pnpm probe:onboarding`.
